ui.tz_milestone_guide: Te hora e tauira (UTC{tz_str}): Te paheke hei whakatika i te rohe wa; ko te neke i te UTC ka neke pea i tētahi kaihoko ki te rā o mua, o muri rānei.
ui.tz_col_target: Wā UTC{tz_str} me te Hurihanga Rā
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Mīhini Wā: Neke i ngā rā ki muri, ki mua rānei i runga i te paheke hei tirotiro i ngā raraunga/matapae o mua, o anamata rānei, hei whakatairite i te hitori, hei whakatairite hoki i ngā āhuatanga. Mātakitaki-anake; kāore i pāhia ngā raraunga pūtake.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN take: he pai ki ngā raraunga tūturu, ka tirotiro i te rere o te wāhanga & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + te wiri puta noa i te k, p; i ngā āputa 16 / 116 / 132, i te huringa 1072 rānei ka whakamahi i te k*116 + p*16 puta noa i te k, p hei ōrite ki te wāhanga, hei whakakī i ngā āputa ki mua mēnā kua ngaro.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Ka noho ki te manawataki 119 (k*119 + wiri); ina ko te āputa he 16 / 116 / 132, ka pā rānei ki te huringa 1072 (tauira 14-hīkoi), ka whakamahi i te k*116 + p*16 puta noa i te k, p hei neke ki roto i te Wāhanga A (A4 / A3) e ōrite ana.
ui.tz_rule_last: Ka takai i te manawataki 119 (k*119 + wiri); i ngā āputa 16 / 116 / 132, i te huringa 1072 rānei (k*116 + p*16 puta noa i te k, p), e tautoko ana i te wāhanga whakatika A2 / C7, ā, ka hoki ki muri ina ngaro ngā raraunga.
